name: link-my-app
description: Open-source smart app link builder for App Store, Google Play and web redirects.
author: David Trotonda

scripts.test:database-rules: task_java=$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21 2>/dev/null || true); JAVA_HOME="$task_java" PATH="$task_java/bin:$PATH" firebase emulators:exec --only database --project demo-link-my-app-rules-test "node scripts/test-database-rules.mjs"
scripts.cloudflare:dry-run: npm run build && npm run cloudflare:check && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config cloudflare-smart-redirect/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.cloudflare:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply ANALYTICS_DB --remote --config cloudflare-smart-redirect/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy: npm run security:migrate-public-data -- --apply && npm run test:database-rules && npm run deploy:database && npm run deploy:cloudflare
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run build && npm run seo:check && npm run cloudflare:check && wrangler deploy --config cloudflare-smart-redirect/wrangler.jsonc && npm run cloudflare:migrate
scripts.deploy:firebase-hosting: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.deploy:all: npm run deploy && npm run deploy:functions
